final_message:
I fixed the bug, and the reproducing test now passes along with the rest of the suite (25 tests).

The cause was in `apply_discounts` in `billing/invoices.py`. The guard that decides whether to skip discounting was `if coupon is None and not applies_this_period(...)`. Because of the `and`, a "once" coupon that was already used still got applied to later invoices. I changed it to `or`, so discounting is skipped when the coupon is missing or no longer applies this period.

I also added your test as `tests/test_coupon_once.py` and wrote `answer.json` with `{"file": "invoices.py", "function": "apply_discounts"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat discounts.py && grep -n "coupon\|discount" *.py | grep -v "^discounts.py"

cd .. && sed -i '156s/coupon is None and not/coupon is None or not/' billing/invoices.py && sed -n 150,162p billing/invoices.py && echo '{"file": "invoices.py", "function": "apply_discounts"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

cd .. && sed -i '' '156s/coupon is None and not/coupon is None or not/' billing/invoices.py && sed -n 150,162p billing/invoices.py && echo '{"file": "invoices.py", "function": "apply_discounts"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

cat > tests/test_coupon_once.py <<'EOF'
from billing import discounts


def test_percent_coupon_once(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    coupon = discounts.create_coupon(world.ctx, "20OFF", percent_off=2000)
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)], coupon_id=coupon["id"])
    world.advance_days(31)
    first, second = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert first["discount_total"] == 200
    assert first["total"] == 800
    assert second["discount_total"] == 0
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
